critical_code_review_comments: SubscribersPage.js:493 — the row 'تمديد' (extend) RefreshCw button was MISSING a data-testid in the initial commit. I added data-testid='extend-open-{tenant.id}' to make the flow Playwright-testable (the dialog opens correctly). Main agent should standardize: every interactive button in tenant rows should carry a testid, not just the dialog content.

platform_stats_routes.py:50-58 — Redis fast-path reads the cache but the cached payload still includes the 'generated_at' timestamp from when it was first computed. Consider stamping a fresh 'served_at' alongside 'cached:true' so consumers can see how stale the data is (currently they only know it's cached, not by how much).

platform_stats_routes.py:110-118 — the redis ping in service-health uses a fresh client per request instead of the singleton cache.ping(). This duplicates connection setup and bypasses the broken-state circuit breaker in RedisCache. Consider exposing cache.ping() and reusing it here.

email_service.py:34 — sender defaults to 'onboarding@resend.dev' when SENDER_EMAIL is empty. Resend will reject sends from this domain unless verified; in production with RESEND_API_KEY set but SENDER_EMAIL unset, real sends will silently fail. Recommend hard-failing at startup if RESEND_API_KEY is set but SENDER_EMAIL is empty.

CardsServicePage.js: tab-sales loads on every render. The /platform-cards/sales fetch should be debounced/paginated for tenants with many sales — current implementation loads the full list. Add pagination or a date-range filter before this hits a tenant with 10k+ sales.

Iter 15 regression risk: legacy SaasAdminPage still inlines all 7 dialogs. Now that SubscribersPage extraction is done, the legacy inline-dialog code in SaasAdminPage.js is dead code from a routing standpoint. Recommend a follow-up to delete it (or at minimum mark the file with a deprecation comment) to prevent drift between two copies of the same dialog logic.
